newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Enterprise Oil finds gas shows in Irish well.
newsitem.headline: Enterprise Oil finds gas shows in Irish well.

text.p: Enterprise Oil Plc said on Thursday that its Corrib North Well in the Slyne Trough offshore the west of Ireland had reached total depth of 4370 metres and it was preparing to conduct a well-testing operation.

"The well has encountered gas shows, the significance of which will be determined following full evaluation of all data obtained from the well including the test results," Enterprise Oil said in a statement.
Testing is expected to be completed by the end of October.
"We are encouraged to have encountered a potential gas reservoir but it is far too early to say whether or not the find is commercial," John McGoldrick, area manager for the Atlantic Margin said.
"The test will provide us with additional valuable data which will allow a complete evaluation of the well," he said.
Enterprise Oil has a 45 percent stake and operates the well. Its partners are Santa Fe Exploration, which has a 40 percent interest and Statoil which owns 15 percent.
